data.scalars_csv: data/magnet/igse_predictions.csv (columns used: sample_id, frequency_Hz, temperature_C, amplitude_T, waveform, measured_W_m3)
data.b_waveform_npy: data/magnet/N87/B.npy (40616 x 1024, float64, one period, endpoint excluded)
data.simulator: pool lookup: querying a pool sample_id reveals its measured y; nothing else

features.duty: mean(diff_periodic(B) > 0)  (fraction of samples with rising flux)
features.plateau: existing magnet_igse.classify plateau fraction: mean(|diff| < 0.1 * quantile(|diff|, 0.9))
features.shape: log10( mean( (|diff_periodic(B)| * 1024 * f)^1.5 ) / (4 * f * Bpk)^1.5 ), i.e. log10(mean(|dB/dt|^1.5) / (4 f Bpk)^1.5)
features.cell_for_mixed: waveform class (sine/triangle/trapezoid, existing B-only rule) x temperature (25/50/70/90) = 12 cells

split.H: int(first 8 hex chars of the prereg commit SHA, 16)
split.T6_CAL6: same rng continued: perm = rng.permutation(noncorner_ids_sorted); T6 = perm[:300]; CAL6 = perm[300:400]
split.pool: all ids minus C6, T6, CAL6 (n=40016; contains 432 corner ids)
split.R_k: np.random.default_rng(H + 100 + k).choice(sorted(pool minus S0_k), 120, replace=False); order = acquisition order (batch b = elements 20(b-1)..20b-1)

model.name: M2-magnet: OLS linear mean on linear_mean_features + residual GP on standardized gp_inputs + sigma-normalized split conformal
model.scaler: sklearn StandardScaler fit on the arm's current training gp_inputs
model.conformal: scores |y - mu| / sigma on CAL6 (n=100); q = 91st smallest score (ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)) = 91); interval mu +/- q*sigma
model.refit: hyperparameters re-optimized at every batch and for the final model

acquisition.candidates: pool minus S0_k minus points already selected by this arm (C6/T6/CAL6 never candidates, never read)
acquisition.A: kriging believer on GP posterior std incl. WhiteKernel (as round 3): within a batch, hyperparameters and y normalization fixed, Cholesky augmented with each chosen point; pick argmax sigma; tie -> lowest sample_id
acquisition.M: same believer, score = sigma / sqrt(1 + a_c), a_c = number of points already selected by this arm (excluding S0) in candidate's cell (12 cells)

metrics.coverage: count of y in [mu - q sigma, mu + q sigma]
metrics.winkler: mean Winkler score, alpha=0.1, log10 units: (U-L) + (2/alpha)(L-y)[y<L] + (2/alpha)(y-U)[y>U]
metrics.relative_error: median over set of |10^mu - P| / P

tests.type: exact one-sided sign-flip permutation over K=8 pair differences: p = #{s in {-1,+1}^8 : mean(s*d) >= mean(d)} / 256 (identity included, ties counted, >= compared with 1e-12 tolerance)
tests.gatekeeping: fixed sequence: stop at first non-rejection; later hypotheses 'not tested' (nominal p report-only)

validity.per_arm: C1: T6 coverage >= 240/300; C2: C6 coverage >= 160/200 AND mean width(C6) <= 3 * mean width(T6)
validity.CV_X: >= 7 of 8 arms of method X pass C1 and C2

execution.memory_watchdog: pause when MemAvailable < 3.8 GiB, resume when > 4.3 GiB

report_only: iGSE baseline (existing round-W2 temperature-wise parameters) median relative error on C6/T6
learning curves: C6/T6 Winkler, coverage, RE after each batch b=0..6 for every arm (R uses its first 20b points)
per-arm q, MAE(log10), bias, coverage, width; corner points sampled per arm; cell distribution of selected points
all pair differences; nominal p of untested hypotheses
